title: On OPPO and OnePlus phones the gym's automatic reminders can arrive with no sound, and the app's own rescue sound never plays for them
what: Plan ending, birthday wish, welcome and the other automatic reminders are set ahead of time on their own notification kind, 'Gym reminders', and show at 9:30 am while the app is closed. OPPO and OnePlus take the sound and banner off notification kinds of apps they do not know. The app's rescue sound is only played for 'Messages from your gym', never for 'Gym reminders', and a reminder set ahead gives the app no moment to play it anyway. So on those phones the reminder lands silently in the list and nothing tells the member or the owner.
expected: Gym reminders make a sound on OPPO and OnePlus too, or the member is told once that this phone silences them and shown how to turn the sound back on.
who: members on OPPO and OnePlus phones
fix_line: Give gym reminders the same sound check as gym messages, or warn the member once on those phones

title: A 'your plan ends' reminder can still pop up after the member has renewed at the desk
what: The phone sets the plan-ending reminders days ahead from the plan it last read, and drops them only when it plans again with a fresh copy that shows the renewal. If the phone has not read the gym since the desk renewed the plan (no signal, the app not opened, the phone maker holding the 15-minute check), the 9:30 am reminder still says the plan ends in 3 days or today, though the member has already paid.
expected: Once the plan is renewed, no plan-ending reminder reaches the member.
who: members who renew a few days before the plan ends
how_often: sometimes: when the phone has not read the gym between the renewal and the next 9:30 am
fix_line: Have the gym send a quiet nudge that makes the phone plan again after a renewal, or check the plan just before showing the reminder
